commitMessage:
Complete Indonesian translation and fall back to English

- Translate ~330 remaining English strings in id.json and add the 5
  missing keys (incl. eventGeofenceCrossed) that rendered as blank text
- Fix mistranslations: Drivers was 'Antarmuka', plural menus were
  'Semua ...'; use 'Geofence' and 'Kejadian' consistently
- Missing keys in any language now fall back to English
- Billing is labelled 'Langganan' in Indonesian
- Remove the upstream Transifex workflow, which would overwrite the
  fork's translations if run
